Market today: Tech is still the driver, but rising rates are a constant headwind. Your concentrated tech/chip book, especially on margin, means drawdowns hit hard.

Your holdings: SOXL (-32.21%) and SPAL (-21.11%) are the clear SELL/TRIM candidates needing attention. They are leveraged and decaying.

Watch: Keep an eye on AVGO and AMD scanner setups for potential new ideas if they confirm.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your leveraged losers and watching for confirmation on potential new longs.
plays: Trim SOXL and SPAL: These leveraged ETFs are bleeding and decay is a killer on margin.
Consider AVGO: Scanner shows a WATCH setup (8/12) with entry 371.07-370.7, stop 368.57. Worth validating.
Consider AMD: Scanner shows an ACCUMULATE setup (8/12) with entry 632.21-631.5, stop 628.85. Worth validating.
